newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-MARADONA AGREES TO PAY FOR HOTEL DAMAGE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MARADONA AGREES TO PAY FOR HOTEL DAMAGE.

text.p: Former Argentine captain Diego Maradona has agreed to pay for damage caused to an Alicante hotel where he was a guest.
Five chairs, a table, a marble ashtray, a door, a ceiling and the doors of a lift were damaged in incidents following Maradona's return to the hotel in the early hours of Wednesday.
Angel Gonzalez, assistant director of maintenance at Alicante's Melia hotel, said Maradona had agreed to pay for the damage.
"He was in a very strange state, very excited, he even shouted at the hotel manager `I'm in charge around here'," said Gonzalez.
Maradona has twice been suspended from soccer for drug abuse, in 1992 and 1994, and has been arrested in Argentina for cocaine possession.
Maradona, who left Alicante for Madrid later on Wednesday, has said he would make a decision on whether to retire while in Spain over the next 10 days.
